text: Men are disturbed not by things, but by the views which they take of them.
author: Epictetus

archive.text: Obstacles are those frightful things you see when you take your eyes off your goal.
archive.author: Henry Ford

archive.text: The superior man is satisfied and composed; the mean man is always full of distress.
archive.author: Confucius

archive.text: To see what is right and not to do it is want of courage.
archive.author: Confucius

archive.text: You always own the option of having no opinion. There is never any need to get worked up about things you cannot control.
archive.author: Marcus Aurelius

archive.text: I can never read all the books I want; I can never be all the people I want and live all the lives I want.
archive.author: Sylvia Plath

archive.text: Wisdom is the reward you get for a lifetime of listening when you'd have preferred to talk.
archive.author: Doug Larson

archive.text: Dwell on the beauty of life.
archive.author: Marcus Aurelius
